title: Updates
description: Elysium checks Docker Hub for a new release every hour and applies it on its own, once no agent is in the middle of a turn. A release that does not come up healthy is rolled back.
loadError: Elysium could not load the update status. Reload the page to try again.

notARelease.label: Not a release
notARelease.description: This build is not a release, so it never updates itself. Releases are what the updater applies.

upToDate.label: Up to date
upToDate.description: Elysium is running the newest release.

heldBack.label: Held back
heldBack.description: Release {{release}} rolled back here before, so it waits for you. Update now to try it again.

waitingForWork.label: Waiting
waitingForWork.description_one: Release {{release}} applies as soon as {{count}} agent turn finishes.
waitingForWork.description_other: Release {{release}} applies as soon as {{count}} agent turns finish.

applying.label: Updating
applying.description: The updater is applying a release. Elysium restarts for a moment and reconnects on its own.

updater.missingDescription: Releases are found but nothing applies them. Turn on auto-update on the host, as docs/infrastructure.md describes.

toasts.applyRequested: The update applies once no agent is in the middle of a turn.
